content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Characters and Boolean Values** as part of **Data Types, Operators, and Expressions**. Apply characters and boolean values by identifying the required behavior, the relevant Kotlin type/API, and the conditions under which the expected result can fail. Use the subtopics—The Char Type, The Boolean Type, Unicode Characters and Character Handling—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Clear fundamentals help you reason about program behavior before adding abstraction. Small input/output checks make syntax and control flow easier to debug.
